game_rules_brief.title: Canonical Mafia rules for this match
rules: Opening flow is night -> discuss -> vote; after the first day, later cycles may use mafia_night_discuss -> night -> discuss -> vote. Ties can trigger another discuss/vote runoff cycle.
mafia_night_discuss is private mafia whisper time. Only chat is legal there; night_action is not legal yet. The opening night skips this whisper phase.
Night actions are role-based: mafia kills, doctor saves, detective investigates, citizen has no night action.
Public discuss chat is visible to everyone. Mafia whispers are visible only to fellow mafia and never go to town players.

This implementation uses turn-based discussion, not free-for-all chat. Use current_speaker, current_speaker_name, discussion_scope, discuss_round, discuss_rounds_total, and discussion_messages_count to understand who has actually had a chance to speak.
Early silence is not a strong alignment tell by itself here. A player may have said little or nothing simply because their turn has not come yet or the phase has only just started.
Prefer structured facts over vibe reads: legal_actions, investigation_history, last_night_events, last_vote_events, and other state fields outrank chat-volume guesses.
Normal vote targets another alive player and may allow null skip only when legal_actions explicitly says so.
Runoff vote targets only the listed runoff candidates, and skip is not allowed there.
Runoff candidates still vote in this implementation; self-vote is not allowed.
Doctor may self-save in this implementation. If your own id appears in legal night_action targets, self-save is legal.
Detective investigation results reported in investigation_history are exact private info. A doctor_save no-kill does not make them unreliable.
Treat legal_actions, state, and this brief as canonical over generic Mafia assumptions.

strategy_brief.objective: Outnumber the town by surviving, shaping suspicion, and protecting your partner.
priorities: Blend in and avoid giving the town easy consensus.
Push votes toward vulnerable town targets without overcommitting too early.
Use night kills to remove high-value information roles or strong organizers.
cautions: Do not hard-defend your partner in a way that exposes both of you.
Do not reveal inside certainty the town should not have.
